attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole notice is one sentence and the name carries no byname, so the only thing that tells him apart is the day: none of the corpus's six men named Marcian — the companion of Peter, of Constantinople, of Cyrrhus, of Durostorum, of Egypt, the emperor — is kept on 11 July in any calendar, and none of them died by the knife in an account of one line. The display name therefore carries the day, as the corpus does for its other bare names. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn.
